items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: And Wilbur Hogan played drums. Bill Jones played guitar. Okay. ... Oh no, you mentioned Hogan and Bill Jones. Yeah. Bill Jones played guitar and Hogan played drums. Okay. And that was with the Lloyd Price band?

ctx.x: And then, uh, I don't know what happened, but they fired Keg and got me. I stayed there and, uh, and Steve Valenti, who owned the paddock, had my name outside, all over the place. And he was on, uh, big letters, Wallace Devonville, uh, said it like, and didn't put Bill's name out there. And Bill got mad. And he started giving me a hard way to go, so I quit.
